answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 66000 Country: India Title: Sadaqah on behalf of the Holy Prophet Muhammad, may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him. Question: Can we do sadaqah on behalf of Prophet Mohammed (SAW) and also on behalf of Sahabah? Can we give hadiya to someone on behalf of Prophet Mohammed (SAW)? Answer ID: 66000 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 831/831/M=09/1437) Yes, one may do sadaqah on behalf of the Holy Prophet Muhammad, may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, and of his Companions, may Allah be pleased with them. And something may be given as gift on behalf of the Holy Prophet Muhammad, may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him. The rewards of all these deeds shall reach to the Holy Prophet Muhammad, may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, and to his Companions, may Allah be pleased with them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
